name: train_spec_riven_h
description: Dispatch marker for the human-anchored Riven track (Jeremy, 8 Nov): starts from lab/learn/nets/replay_base.rbpn, the general net taught to replay the human games move for move (lab/learn/replay_imitate.py: 91% of the human moves of 58 games, 52.5% on 15 unseen ones); trains by self-play (the reward of winning) with its policy pulled toward that human net (--human-anchor, --prev-weight 0.5) and Riven's human decisions weighted 10. Adopted on the jury like the other specialists, with the human-agreement guard. 4 runners taken from Mordekaiser.
